rulesText.before: 入场：[快速] 为全体友方随从分配8点护甲，战场上每个你的随从令护甲数值额外+2。

artDescription.before: Standalone vertical game artwork for Time-Block Hero, portrait 5:8 composition, Rare minion. A mobile Astra Imperium engineering robot braces itself beside an unfinished allied titan, unfolding four articulated construction arms toward separate work zones while welding, fastening armor, feeding cable, and calibrating a joint at the same time. Its compact black-steel body combines a stable multi-legged base, dark-red armored housings, retractable tools, bright inspection optics, and heavy magnetic anchors, making it read as both machine and deployable construction platform. Keep the robot, all four purposeful tool arms, and the incomplete titan joint readable inside the upper square crop; use the lower portrait extension for scaffold feet, cables, sparks, and receding factory floor. Specific industrial action, clear functional silhouette, layered but controlled mechanical detail, warm weld light against cool steel, premium industrial sci-fi anime rendering. Artwork only; no readable text, logo, watermark, UI, card frame, decorative border, arrows, cost, or stat icons.
artDescription.after: Rare Astra Imperium MEDIUM-SIZED general-purpose autonomous flying construction assistant, a substantial work vehicle rather than a small drone or humanoid robot. The broad central fuselage is the size of a delivery truck, about four meters long, with total lift-unit span around seven meters. Four powerful enclosed vector-thrust lift nacelles support a heavy rectangular crimson-and-gunmetal modular hull with a clearly readable underside cargo bay, cable winch, tool racks and standardized replacement modules. Four robust non-humanoid articulated construction booms perform different useful jobs: one hoists a thick wall panel larger than an adult person, one stabilizes a structural beam, one welds a joint, and one plugs a heavy conduit into an unfinished allied machine. The assistant hovers only a few meters above an industrial construction apron. Two adult helmeted engineers stand on an adjacent gantry at the SAME DEPTH as the drone, each less than half the central hull height, to provide honest unmistakable scale. Arrange the complete wide body, four lift units, large lifted panel and at least one full-height human scale figure within the upper square. Modest low three-quarter side view, no extreme fisheye or miniature city illusion. All limbs are mechanical cranes and tools, not hands or legs. General-purpose utility roles must be obvious; no guns, missiles, cockpit pilot or combat-fighter silhouette. Lower portrait extends through scaffolds, power spools and the construction apron. Controlled warm weld light and cold lift exhaust, crisp anime mecha illustration with visible contour drawing and simple hard cel-shadows, no photoreal microtexture. Standalone vertical card illustration, portrait 5:8. Keep the main machine, decisive action and scale references readable in the upper square crop, with safe margins. Premium Industrial Sci-Fi Anime style with strong hand-drawn contour lines, deliberate cel-shaped value groups and designed highlights, painterly smoke and atmosphere. Matte dark-red ceramic and gunmetal industrial materials; original sci-fi equipment, no photorealism or glossy 3D render. Artwork only; no text, logos, watermarks, card frame, border, arrows, stat icons or other UI.

artDescription.before: Standalone vertical game artwork for Time-Block Hero, portrait 5:8 composition, Epic spell. A veteran Astra Imperium engineer stands over a deep three-dimensional planning table as construction signals arrive from several surrounding directions, each connection resolving a different fragment of an impossible design. With one precise gesture, the fragments lock into multiple complete luminous blueprint prisms that rise toward the viewer, visually translating a well-connected building network into new knowledge rather than showing literal cards. Keep the engineer's focused face, hands, converging signal lines, and completed design prisms readable inside the upper square crop; use the lower portrait extension for layered machinery cutaways, physical model parts, drafting arms, and the surrounding dark laboratory. Sophisticated industrial problem-solving, ambitious perspective, rich brass, black steel, dark-red fabric, and cool projection-light contrast, cinematic depth, premium industrial sci-fi anime rendering. Artwork only; no readable text, logo, watermark, UI, card frame, decorative border, arrows, cost, or stat icons.
artDescription.after: Epic Astra Imperium construction spell. Preserve the established mature male engineer with swept dark hair, focused expression, charcoal technical coat and dark-red high collar, but show a concrete act of distributed construction instead of gathering knowledge. He directs a limited set of fabrication arms across several incomplete allied structures on a vast industrial assembly deck; one actuator closes a tower brace, another seats a machine armor panel, and a third locks a conduit into an unfinished support frame. The structures remain at visibly different completion stages; this is allocated incremental work, not instant creation of a completed city. His hand and the nearest assembly junction dominate the upper square; other work sites recede in layered depth into the lower portrait. Crisp meaningful machinery, cool inspection projection lines without text, restrained golden weld light, dark red cloth and matte black steel, Epic ambitious perspective and controlled narrative detail. Standalone vertical card artwork for Time-Block Hero, portrait 5:8. Keep the decisive subject and action within the upper square crop, with edge clearance; the lower extension carries environmental depth. Premium industrial sci-fi anime illustration, crisp contour drawing, designed cel-shaped shadows and highlights, matte engineered materials and painterly atmosphere; no photorealism, glossy 3D or chibi styling. rulesText.before: [箭头需求: 3, 可建造] 发动：每回合限两次，选择一个友方建筑，将其瞬移到其距离3以内的一个空格子上。

rulesText.before: [循环进度：3] 计数：你放置卡牌的张数。完成：随机点亮本随从一个尚未点亮的箭头方向。
rulesText.after: [循环进度：4] 计数：你放置卡牌的张数。完成：随机点亮本随从一个尚未点亮的箭头方向。

rulesText.before: [循环进度：4] 计数：你发动或触发与本卡不同名的卡牌效果的次数。完成：为其5x5范围内的友方随从恢复1点剩余行动点。
rulesText.after: [循环进度：4] 计数：你发动或触发与本卡不同名的卡牌效果的次数。完成：为行动点不满的友方随从随机恢复总计3点行动点。

rulesText.before: [循环进度：30] 计数：友方机械随从移动的总格数。完成：随机填满你场上三张卡牌的进度；不足3个时全部触发。
rulesText.after: [循环进度：30] 计数：友方机械随从移动的总格数。完成：随机填满你场上三张卡牌的进度。

rulesText.before: [循环进度：5] 计数：该随从移动的格数。完成：对最近的一个非友方随从造成4点伤害；距离相同时随机选择。
rulesText.after: [循环进度：4] 计数：该随从移动的格数。完成：对最近的一个非友方随从造成4点伤害；距离相同时随机选择。

rulesText.before: [循环进度：7] 计数：你获得星能的数量。完成：复原你本回合的移动点数和攻击次数。
rulesText.after: 圣盾。[循环进度：7] 计数：你获得星能的数量。完成：获得圣盾，复原你本回合的移动点数和攻击次数。

Preserve the established coherent elongated SIX-LIMBED body, forked frontal sensory crown, paired translucent pressure vanes, obsidian-blue skin, pale causal stripes and cyan phase edges. Show three paired sets of limbs on one continuous body, never a broken or fragmented Hollow-Null anatomy. Its crown parts a narrow flowing time seam; beside the dive path a spent spell apparatus returns to an earlier charged configuration, expressed by a controlled returning light sequence, without UI or literal cards. Dynamic three-quarter view, crown and forebody uppermost, the long tail curling into the lower portrait; distant intact gantries and suspended dust establish ordered time displacement. added.artDescription: Rare Astra Imperium tactical spell, Operation Osprey. A low-flying original military tilt-rotor assault transport breaches a defended industrial front line and air-drops imperial conscripts directly into the enemy position. The narrative is vertical insertion from sky to hostile ground: the aircraft is clearly in flight with two large rotating lift nacelles and an open troop ramp, two armored conscripts are visibly descending on separate rappel lines, and another has just touched down beside hostile barricades. Their dark-red standardized armor distinguishes them from an off-white enemy defender turning toward the sudden incursion. Downwash lifts dust, tracer streaks pass behind the transport, and troops spread to opposite sides of the enemy position after landing. Show the aircraft and suspended troops together in the upper square, with a low three-quarter dramatic view across the broken defensive line; the lower extension contains the landing zone, debris and receding trench structures. This must read immediately as an airborne assault onto an enemy line, not soldiers walking out of ground passages and not an osprey bird. No modern real-world military logos, copied real aircraft markings or science-fantasy teleport portals. Standalone vertical card illustration, portrait 5:8. Keep the main machine, decisive action and scale references readable in the upper square crop, with safe margins. Premium Industrial Sci-Fi Anime style with strong hand-drawn contour lines, deliberate cel-shaped value groups and designed highlights, painterly smoke and atmosphere. Matte dark-red ceramic and gunmetal industrial materials; original sci-fi equipment, no photorealism or glossy 3D render. Artwork only; no text, logos, watermarks, card frame, border, arrows, stat icons or other UI.

semanticDecisions.FNG-033: 删除默认每回合一次只是卡文精简，实际每能力每回合一次保持；5护甲改圣盾。
semanticDecisions.MCC-005: 删除不足说明仅卡文精简，随机不同卡牌不足3全取、填满逻辑保持；费用12、生命10。
semanticDecisions.MCC-014: 随机分配算法说明删除不改行为；点数6改4，逐点等概率有放回，汇总同批。
semanticDecisions.MCC-004: 不同名来源计数保持；取消5×5，改全场随机分配3行动点，按实际缺口封顶、缺口不足不浪费。
semanticDecisions.FNG-040: 尽可能选3不同友方随从赋圣盾；不足3全取，另全体治疗2。
semanticDecisions.FNG-041: 重置己方场上法术全部主动能力已用次数，不自动执行、不返还成本；魔法卡规范为法术牌。
semanticDecisions.AI-009: 循环3改4，计数受电能加成，完成减免恒1。
semanticDecisions.AI-022: 费用6；自家牌堆与弃牌堆联合候选召唤征召兵，左右合法格尽可能执行。
